title: Untitled (Figures with Discs)
description: Two overlapping drawn figures rendered in loose black ink on white ground, each incorporating a physical compact disc — one as a face, one at the shoulder. Red ink marks and a drawn heart accent the lower figure's torso, with scribbled line work throughout.
composition: two overlapping figures with embedded discs
dimensions_source: CD reference: single disc (r=98.0px native), fully visible in the figure's mouth. A second disc near the frame edge was excluded as cropped/unreliable. Visually confirmed. Estimated 2026-08-03.
